c74object.name: el.distortion~
c74object.digest: Waveshaping distortion processor with variable knee and ceiling
c74object.description:
el.distortion~ is a waveshaping distortion processor that applies a piecewise transfer function with a variable knee threshold and cut ceiling. Incoming signal amplitudes below the knee threshold pass through linearly without coloration. Amplitudes above the knee are compressed, saturated, and rescaled based on the knee and cut parameters. Both parameters can be adjusted via float messages or modulated continuously at audio rate via signal inlets.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal): Audio input to be distorted. Also accepts the mute message.
Inlet 2 (signal / float): Knee threshold. Sets the amplitude level where non-linear waveshaping begins.
Inlet 3 (signal / float): Cut / ceiling. Sets the upper boundary for the distortion transfer curve (must be greater than knee, clamped between 0.001 and 1.0).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Distorted audio output signal.

inlet.description: Incoming audio signal to be processed.
Sets the threshold where distortion begins (minimum 0.000001). Can be set by float message or modulated continuously at audio rate.
Sets the ceiling endpoint of the distortion transfer curve (clamped between 0.001 and 1.0). Can be set by float message or modulated continuously at audio rate.

outlet.description: The processed, waveshaped audio output signal.

objarg.name: knee
objarg.description: The threshold where distortion begins (default: 0.1). Must be less than the cut parameter and greater than 0.

objarg.name: cut
objarg.description: The endpoint ceiling of the distortion transfer function (default: 0.3). Must be greater than the knee and up to 1.0.

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 2 updates the knee threshold. Float sent to inlet 3 updates the cut ceiling.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. 0 restores normal distortion processing.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the main audio to process. Signals connected to inlets 2 or 3 modulate the knee threshold and cut ceiling on a sample-by-sample basis.
